name: Ricardo Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo Mendoza's journey into motorsport marketing began unexpectedly. Initially a journalist covering South American rally events, he quickly realized his passion lay not in reporting, but in crafting the narrative. He transitioned into team communications, leveraging his insider knowledge and innate understanding of the sport's allure. Ricardo brings a no-nonsense approach to his role, prioritizing data-driven decisions and measurable results. 

At Alpine F1, Ricardo is responsible for coordinating marketing campaigns, managing sponsor relationships, and ensuring brand consistency across all platforms. He's known for his meticulous planning and his unwavering commitment to exceeding expectations. What distinguishes Ricardo is his ability to blend traditional marketing strategies with innovative approaches, always seeking an edge in the highly competitive world of Formula 1. He’s a vocal advocate for utilizing Latin American cultural themes to broaden the sport’s appeal.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build with a distinguished air about him.

quirks: Insists on using a specific brand of Colombian coffee, even when traveling.
Always carries a small notebook filled with marketing ideas and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
